newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers ease in thin activity.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers ease in thin activity.

text.p: North American bunker prices eased late this week amid a dearth of news and little activity ahead of the Easter holiday, players said Thursday.
"Demand is really, really light," said one East Coast player.
In New York Harbor, bids for 380 CST slipped $1 to $93 a tonne, with offers remaining at $95. 180 CST stayed stable at $99/100.
Philadelphia was trading a $1 premium to New York.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston 380 CST was on par with New York but 180 CST was $97/99, $1 down from Tuesday.
